title: Semantic output of the quadratic circuit adapter
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with a positive number of input bits, and let an output-sensitive adapter be built for a binary encoding of circuits. The semantic PCPP description produced by the adapter for $C$ equals the canonical three-query PCPP description obtained from the quadratic circuit construction.
hypotheses_covered: The adapter is for a binary encoding of Boolean circuits
$C$ is a Boolean circuit with positive input length
